biggest_catch: Your reward amount is set by YOUR FRIEND's primary fuel use — Heat $150, Pool $75, Hot Water $50, all others $25 — so you can't know the payout until they enroll, and the friend must sign a contract and take their first fill within 90 days.
catches: Tiered by referred customer's primary use: Heat $150, Pool $75, Hot Water $50, all others $25 — the amount is outside the referrer's control.
Referral must be a new monitored customer who signs a contract and receives their first propane fill within 90 days; already-installed leased tank transfers are excluded.
A yearly minimum tank fill is required for the free monitoring service on the referred account.
Visa Reward Card has no cash access; terms, conditions and expiration apply.
Propane pricing varies; compare plan rates before your friend switches.
